ashley: T-minus 40 for the runtime hotfix. Quick preflight — who can sign smoke + confirm rollback readiness? I'm owner for rollout and will coordinate.

devon: I can run prod smoke on the /inference routes. Will run warmup + baseline latency and post results. ETA ~18:30 UTC.

mike: Confirming rollback ownership if needed. I have a tag ready and will execute rollback steps. Also note the toggle is reversible.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window reserved at 18:30 UTC. Reserved 2x A100 nodes. Canary 10% for 5 min.

ashley: Short checklist (keeping it terse):
- [ ] prod smoke signoff (devon)
- [ ] rollback ready (mike)
- [ ] QA smoke green (tara)
- [ ] alerting/watch assigned (sre-oncall)
- [ ] runbook link posted (ashley)

tara: QA: I'll run the canary smoke at 18:33 and verify sample prompts + hallucination checks. Need the exact route list and test prompts.

devon: Route list: `/generate`, `/chat`, `/embed`. Warmup command I'm using: `curl -sS -X POST $API/generate -d '{"prompt":"hotfix smoke"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'` — will post baseline numbers.

sre-oncall: Alerting: added a composite alarm combining error-rate > 1% and 95p latency > 800ms. I'll monitor for 15 minutes post-canary and have escalation ready. Pager duty is me.

mike: Rollback plan (short):
1) flip `feature.flag.runtime_hotfix` -> false
2) scale down new pods to 0 and restore previous replica set weights
3) verify traffic back to stable; validate QPS and error-rate
Tag to roll back: `rollback/runtime-hotfix-2024-03-18`
I have creds and will execute if devon or tara report failures.

ashley: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runtime-hotfix-runbook (link posted)
Everyone: please react with :white_check_mark: when you have the step covered. Call out if you need a hand.

devon: :white_check_mark: I'll post baseline + canary numbers when done.

tara: :white_check_mark: QA will report within 7m of canary.

mike: :white_check_mark: Rollback ready and documented.
